file.planRule: Your plan uses its own holding rule. This file uses the {country} rule.
file.perVenue: Sales are matched per venue as named in the Log. Entries with no venue are one group.
file.crossVenue: In {count, plural, one {{figure} row} other {{figure} rows}}, the sale took units bought at another venue. sale_venue shows where those sales were made.
file.pooledListed: For a coin sold in the tax year, every purchase and sale to {to} is listed for the pool. Its purchases to {windowEnd} are listed for the 30-day rule.
file.rawListed: For a coin sold in the tax year, every purchase and sale to {to} is listed.
file.windowOpen: Made on {today}: purchases after that day are not in this file.
file.format: Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Amounts and units use a decimal point.
file.uncosted: On a held row, an empty cost_basis means no cost was recorded, not a cost of zero. Rows with no acquired date leave cost_basis empty.
file.uncostedRaw: On a held row, an empty cost_basis means no cost was recorded, not a cost of zero. Sale rows leave cost_basis empty.
file.estimated: units_estimated yes: {product}'s Bought as planned button filled in the units from the day's price, not from your exchange's confirmation. Any fee or venue it copied came from your latest purchase or sale that recorded one.
file.estimatedBlock: units_estimated yes: the sale or a holding row in its block counts units that {product}'s Bought as planned button filled in from the day's price, not from your exchange's confirmation. Any fee or venue it copied came from your latest purchase or sale that recorded one.
file.unmatched: A row with no acquired date is a sale that no logged purchase covered.
file.ongoing: The tax year ends on {to}. This file shows your log as of {today}.
file.cessions: Each block is one sale from your log: a holding row for each coin held just before it, then the sale row. Purchases have no rows here: the CSV log lists every entry. The calculation from these figures is left to you or your accountant.
file.cessionPrices: On holding rows, the coin sold is valued at its own sale price. The other coins carry no market price in this file. estimated_portfolio_value is filled only when the coin sold was the only coin held and your log holds the units sold.
file.cessionCosts: purchase_costs_to_date sums the amounts of the purchases and the recorded costs of the Coins added entries logged before each sale, and purchase_fees_to_date their fees. Neither is reduced by earlier sales. Amounts are as you logged them, whether or not they include a fee.
file.heldWithoutCost: held_without_cost_to_date: how many Coins added entries before the sale have no recorded cost. purchase_costs_to_date leaves them out.
file.snapshotReference: units_on_{opening} is your log at the start of {reference}, which is the end of {eve}. {ongoing, select, yes {units_on_{closing} stays empty until the year has ended.} other {units_on_{closing} is your log at the end of {to}.}}
file.snapshotValues: This file holds units and logged amounts but no market prices, so the value_on_{opening} and value_on_{closing} cells are empty, except 0.00 where you held none.
file.heldInYear: held_units counts the units of Coins added entries dated in this year. If you had those coins before {reference}, units_on_{opening} leaves them out.
file.heldCost: An empty held_cost means a Coins added entry has no recorded cost, not a cost of zero.
file.estimatedUnits: Some units come from {product}'s Bought as planned button, filled in from the day's price, not from your exchange's confirmation. Any fee it copied came from your latest purchase or sale that recorded one.
